title: [Digital twins in uro-oncology].
qc_rationale: The review combines tumor reconstruction, virtual pathology, static risk assessment, and surgical 3D twins; learned or adapted transition models with direct dynamics evaluation are not a central evidence category.
full_text_anchor: Structured abstract, Methods and Results: representative applications include tumor reconstruction, virtual assessment, and patient-specific 3D surgical planning.

title: A data-driven Alzheimer's disease progression simulator for retrospective validation and prospective Phase III power design.
qc_rationale: SimulAD learns a latent ODE transition over amyloid, tau, MRI, and cognition from longitudinal ADNI data, then evaluates intervention-conditioned multistep trajectories against six Phase III trials and power outcomes.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint, Methods and Results: latent ODE with piecewise amyloid-clearance interventions; retrospective simulation of TRAILBLAZER-ALZ2, CLARITY AD, EMERGE, ENGAGE, and GRADUATE I/II.

title: A digital twin for hospital antimicrobial resistance forecasting and constrained intervention optimisation
qc_rationale: Temporal graph and transformer models learn resistance-spread transitions from evolving hospital contact states; branched screening and isolation policies are evaluated by future-state forecasts and within-state action ranking.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint, forecasting and intervention experiments: daily contact-network prediction, surveillance stress tests, distribution shifts, and policy branching under shock and superspreader conditions.

title: A Digital Twin Framework for Predictive Modeling and Intervention Optimization in Inflammatory Bowel Disease
qc_rationale: Only a registered IEEE conference record and title were stably inspectable; no extractable methods, learned transition, dataset, or operational dynamics results support 45-field extraction.
full_text_anchor: IEEE DOI record and Crossref metadata: title and bibliographic registration only; no stable abstract or full methods/results text located.

title: A digital twin-enhanced decision support system improves time-in-range in type 1 diabetes: a randomized clinical trial.
qc_rationale: The glucose transition is a first-principles physiological model personalized once by heuristic adjustment of four parameters, without formal fitting or learned dynamics; the RCT evaluates its forecasts but does not satisfy the learned-transition condition.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Study devices and interventions and Model structure: three physiological models with four parameters manually adjusted by the study physician; no optimization algorithm was used.

title: A Model to Assess the Outcomes Associated With Dementia With Lewy Bodies.
qc_rationale: The structured abstract reports estimated annual state-transition probabilities and cohort simulation, but the accessible primary record is too thin to audit model fitting, validation, and the full extraction schema.
full_text_anchor: PubMed and publisher record, structured abstract only: longitudinal cognitive data, estimated transition probabilities, and a closed-cohort health-state model.

title: A Modular Framework to Predict Alzheimer’s Disease Progression Using Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks
qc_rationale: A conditional GAN learns longitudinal Alzheimer state progression and recursively generates later disease-stage trajectories; future stage outputs are directly compared with held-out longitudinal patient sequences.
full_text_anchor: Author-hosted full paper, framework and experiments: modular cGAN progression across sequential Alzheimer stages with generated-versus-observed trajectory evaluation.

title: A multidimensional ODE-based model of Alzheimer's disease progression
qc_rationale: This row is the Research Square preprint; the same work has a more complete peer-reviewed journal version and only the final publication should be retained.
full_text_anchor: Lineage check: preprint DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-1903006/v1 matches the later Scientific Reports article DOI 10.1038/s41598-023-29383-5.

title: A Novel Coupling Model of Physiological Degradation and Emotional State for Prediction of Alzheimer's Disease Progression.
qc_rationale: The article is published in an MDPI journal, which is excluded by the active literature source policy; it is not retained even though it reports coupled temporal prediction.
full_text_anchor: Publisher and PMC full text identify Brain Sciences as the publication venue; the model couples physiological degradation and emotional-state transition.

title: A unified framework for prediction of liver steatosis dynamics in response to different diet and drug interventions.
qc_rationale: The transition is a deliberately minimal, hand-formulated ODE physiology model assembled from lipid flux assumptions and calibrated to studies, rather than a learned or substantively adapted state-transition model.
full_text_anchor: Primary article, Methods and Discussion: manually formulated ODE lipid-flux structure, parameter estimation in MATLAB, and proposed future use as a disease-progression model.

title: Advancing Precision Oncology with Digital and Virtual Twins: A Scoping Review.
qc_rationale: The review is published in an MDPI journal, which is excluded by the active literature source policy; its broad oncology scope also mixes static and dynamic twin applications.
full_text_anchor: PMC full text and DOI identify Cancers as the venue; the review maps diagnosis, therapy, monitoring, and technical credibility across 30 studies.

title: AI-Guided Inference of Morphodynamic Attractor-like States in Glioblastoma.
qc_rationale: The article is published in an MDPI journal and is excluded by source policy; additionally, its neural-ODE flow is inferred from cross-sectional population variation rather than observed longitudinal tumor transitions.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Methods and Conclusions: BraTS cross-sectional embeddings approximate morphologic continuity; dynamic labels are not a clinically predictive temporal model.

title: AI-powered in silico twins: redefining precision medicine through simulation, personalization, and predictive healthcare.
qc_rationale: Learned and personalized medical dynamics are central: the review organizes in-silico twins around model layers, simulation engines, feedback loops, disease-progression simulation, treatment optimization, calibration, and validation.
full_text_anchor: Full text sections: Core components; Simulation of disease progression; Treatment simulation and optimization; Model calibration and personalization; Verification, validation, and uncertainty quantification.

title: AKI-twinX: explainable organ structured digital twin for sepsis AKI trajectory forecasting
qc_rationale: The model learns coupled renal and cardiovascular latent transitions from MIMIC-IV, validates AKI and blood-pressure trajectories externally, and tests vasopressor-withdrawal counterfactual responses.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint, Methods and Results: organ-structured latent states, Indiana University Health external cohort, 12-hour blood-pressure forecasts, and vasopressor withdrawal perturbation.

title: AlzheimerODE: A Knowledge-Guided Generative Model for Alzheimer's Disease Progression
qc_rationale: A proceedings DOI and laboratory publication listing were found, but no stable primary abstract or full methods/results text was available to verify the learned transition, evaluation protocol, or extraction fields.
full_text_anchor: ACM DOI registration and author laboratory publication page: bibliographic listing only; no inspectable primary methods and results.

title: ARE-GAN: Adaptive Regression and ROI-Enhanced Generative Adversarial Network for Alzheimer Disease Progression Prediction
qc_rationale: ARE-GAN learns longitudinal MRI progression conditioned on patient information and evaluates generated future brain states and progression classification against observed Alzheimer follow-up data.
full_text_anchor: Springer full article, Methods and Results: adaptive regression and ROI-enhanced GAN generation of future MRIs with image-similarity and disease-stage evaluation.

title: Artificial Intelligence, LLM-based generation of synthetic patients with Parkinson’s Disease: towards a digital twin paradigm for in silico studies
qc_rationale: The LLM generates complete synthetic longitudinal records and is evaluated for fidelity, privacy, and downstream utility, but no learned state-transition operator is directly evaluated through forecasting, rollout, or action response.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint, Methods and Results: synthetic PPMI record generation, distributional similarity, neurologist review, privacy tests, and downstream disease-model reuse.

title: Automatic Interactive Evaluation for Large Language Models with State Aware Patient Simulator
qc_rationale: The accessible SSRN registration and title do not expose stable methods and results sufficient to determine whether patient-state transitions are learned from observed clinical data or hand-authored.
full_text_anchor: SSRN DOI record and indexed metadata: title-level evidence only; no complete stable primary text available for extraction.

title: Autosomal Dominant Tubulointerstitial Kidney Disease Clinical Trial Simulator: Case Reports of Model-Informed Drug Development.
qc_rationale: Nonlinear mixed-effects models fit individual eGFR trajectories from longitudinal natural-history data; placebo and treatment trajectories are simulated across trial designs and evaluated by statistical power.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Natural History Models and Case Studies: SAEM-fitted genotype-specific eGFR curves, parameterized drug effects, virtual populations, and trial power simulations.

title: Brain Amyloid Plaque Levels Affect Clinical Progression in Alzheimer Disease: Assessment of Amyloid PET and Change in CDR-SB Utilizing Semi-Mechanistic Model.
qc_rationale: A nonlinear mixed-effects disease-progression transition is fitted to placebo and lecanemab trial trajectories, links amyloid reduction to CDR-SB evolution, and is evaluated through four-year treatment simulations.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Model development and Simulations: Richard's-function CDR-SB progression fit to Studies 201 and 301, amyloid-mediated treatment effect, and four-year projections.

title: Brain Latent Progression: Individual-based spatiotemporal disease progression on 3D Brain MRIs via latent diffusion
qc_rationale: A latent diffusion model learns subject-specific spatiotemporal MRI transitions and directly evaluates generated future brain anatomy across longitudinal follow-up horizons.
full_text_anchor: PMC full text, Method and Experiments: individual-conditioned latent diffusion over longitudinal 3D MRI with future-image similarity, morphometry, and progression evaluation.

title: CardamomOT: a mechanistic optimal transport-based framework for gene regulatory network inference, trajectory reconstruction and generative modeling
qc_rationale: CardamomOT calibrates gene-regulatory and latent protein transitions from time-labeled single-cell data, reconstructs trajectories, and evaluates generation under unseen regulatory perturbations.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint, Results: GRN and protein-trajectory reconstruction on simulated and experimental data, velocity-field recovery, and unseen-perturbation response simulation.

title: Cardiovascular care with digital twin technology in the era of generative artificial intelligence.
qc_rationale: The narrative review spans phenotyping, diagnosis, procedural planning, risk prediction, and future generative-AI possibilities; learned or adapted transition systems with operational rollout evidence are not a consistently central evidence category.
full_text_anchor: Primary review, abstract and application sections: mechanistic and statistical replicas across diagnosis, prognosis, planning, and proposed future real-time predictions.

title: CellPace: A temporal diffusion-forcing framework for simulation, interpolation and forecasting of single-cell dynamics
qc_rationale: CellPace learns continuous developmental transitions with a temporal diffusion transformer and directly evaluates simulation, missing-time interpolation, and extrapolation to unseen future stages.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint, Methods and Results: gap-aware continuous-time conditioning with developmental, spatial-transcriptomic, and joint RNA-chromatin trajectory evaluation.

title: cLDM-ODE: A Multimodal Generative Framework for Uncertainty-Aware Forecasting of Alzheimer's Disease Progression
qc_rationale: Only bibliographic registration and title-level evidence were stably available; the transition model, longitudinal dataset, uncertainty evaluation, and results could not be audited for full extraction.
full_text_anchor: Elsevier DOI and Crossref record: title and publication metadata only; no stable abstract or full methods/results text located.

title: Clinical-GAN: Trajectory Forecasting of Clinical Events using Transformer and Generative Adversarial Networks
qc_rationale: Clinical-GAN learns next-visit clinical-code transitions from ordered MIMIC-IV histories and evaluates generated multivisit trajectories against recurrent and generative baselines.
full_text_anchor: Primary article abstract and repository-linked methods: transformer generator/discriminator trained on more than 500,000 visits from about 196,000 patients; subsequent-visit forecasting experiments.

title: Current progress of digital twin construction using medical imaging.
qc_rationale: The review centers imaging-based twin construction, anatomical representation, diagnosis, and planning; learned longitudinal transitions and operational rollout evaluation are not a central evidence category.
full_text_anchor: Full text and abstract: system-by-system imaging classification, diagnostic and treatment applications, data augmentation, and real-time optimization as future directions.

title: Data-driven discovery of digital twins in biomedical research.
qc_rationale: The review specifically synthesizes 177 methods that infer governing dynamics from biological time series, including learned differential equations, latent variables, perturbations, uncertainty, and benchmark needs.
full_text_anchor: Full text sections: State-of-the-art of digital twin inference from temporal data; symbolic and sparse regression; biological challenges; uncertainty; benchmark development.

title: Data-driven Huntington's disease progression modelling and estimation of societal cost in the UK.
qc_rationale: A continuous-time hidden Markov model learns five Huntington disease states and transition speeds from Enroll-HD visits, then evaluates synthetic patient progression and hypothetical intervention scenarios.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Methods and Results: cross-validated state-number selection, transition-rate estimation, life-expectancy correction, and population simulation under interventions.

title: Data-driven model discovery and model selection for noisy biological systems.
qc_rationale: A neural hybrid dynamical model learns missing biological transition terms from noisy observations, then direct simulations are used to recover governing equations and cell-state transitions.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Methods and Results: neural latent-dynamics fitting, SINDy model recovery, noise stress tests, and single-cell transcriptomic state-transition application.

title: Decomposing heterogeneity in disease progression speeds and pathways.
qc_rationale: DiSPAH learns continuous-time latent disease-state transitions and patient-specific progression speeds from longitudinal ALS scores, reconstructs trajectories, and predicts future course.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Model and Results: hidden Markov transition framework, individualized speed parameter, inferred ALS pathways, and held-out future-course prediction.

title: Deep neural networks for endemic measles dynamics: Comparative analysis and integration with mechanistic models.
qc_rationale: A spatial neural model learns measles transitions from historical incidence and directly evaluates multi-horizon outbreak forecasts; a hybrid PINN also reconstructs latent susceptible dynamics.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Forecasting experiments: England and Wales biweekly incidence, 1- to multi-step RMSE comparisons with TSIR, and latent-susceptible reconstruction.

title: Deep recurrent model for individualized prediction of Alzheimer’s disease progression
qc_rationale: An end-to-end recurrent model learns longitudinal MRI, cognitive, and clinical-state transitions and evaluates predictions at multiple future time points on the TADPOLE cohort.
full_text_anchor: Primary article abstract, Methods and Experiments: joint imputation, biomarker forecasting, cognitive trajectory estimation, and future clinical-status prediction with ablations.

title: Development and validation of a chronic kidney disease progression model using patient-level simulations.
qc_rationale: The patient-level model combines fitted risk equations and calibrated transition probabilities for CKD states and complications, then evaluates evolving outcomes through internal and external validation.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Model development and Validation: KDIGO state transitions, time-dependent eGFR and complication risks, calibration, and comparison with multiple source cohorts.

title: Development of a model-based clinical trial simulation platform to optimize the design of clinical trials for Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
qc_rationale: Nonlinear mixed-effects models fit five longitudinal Duchenne measures from 27,252 observations, externally validate their trajectories, and drive repeated clinical-trial simulations.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Model development and Qualification: five disease trajectories, external datasets, and trial-design simulations for eligibility, endpoints, and assessment schedules.

title: Development of a Novel Machine Learning Method for Estimation of Life-Long Chronic Disease Progression and Its Application to Type 2 Diabetes.
qc_rationale: SReFT-ML learns how fragmented longitudinal observations align on a common disease course, reconstructs 30-year biomarker trajectories, and evaluates recovery on synthetic data and ACCORD patients.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Method and Results: synthetic trajectory-recovery tests, ACCORD reconstruction, long-term biomarker evolution, and outcome-risk associations.

title: Digital twin brain simulator for real-time consciousness monitoring and virtual intervention using primate electrocorticogram data
qc_rationale: A variational Bayesian recurrent model learns latent ECoG transitions with online data assimilation, evaluates real-time signal rollout, and simulates virtual anesthetic intervention effects.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Data assimilation and Virtual intervention Results: macaque awake/anesthetized ECoG prediction, latent-state updating, and drug-administration simulation.

title: Digital twin models for predicting venetoclax and azacitidine-induced neutropenia in patients with acute myeloid leukemia.
qc_rationale: Patient-specific mechanistic transitions for blasts and neutrophils are fitted and continuously updated from treatment data, with future neutropenia trajectories evaluated across patients.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Model fitting and Results: venetoclax/azacitidine response equations, patient-level parameter estimation, forecast-error analysis, subgroup fit, and sequential updating.

title: Digital Twins in Neurology Care: Evidence, Limitations, and a Path Forward.
qc_rationale: This is an opinion spanning many neurological domains and proposed standards; it does not centrally synthesize inspectable learned-transition systems with operational dynamics evaluations.
full_text_anchor: Primary article abstract: conceptual critique across dementia, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson disease, epilepsy, stroke, pain, and migraine; most systems are labeled twin-inspired.

title: Digital twins in precision pharmacotherapy: emerging applications, challenges, and future directions.
qc_rationale: The narrative review emphasizes conceptual translation, clinical-pharmacy workflows, and prospective applications; learned or adapted transition models with direct rollout evidence are not systematically central.
full_text_anchor: Full text sections: conceptual framework, MIPD distinction, use cases, implementation, current status, and future directions.

title: Disease Modeling and External Model Evaluation Through Clinical Data Sharing Platform for HR+/HER2- Breast Cancer.
qc_rationale: A tumor-growth inhibition transition is fitted to longitudinal breast-cancer measurements and linked to survival, then externally evaluated on two independent Phase III trials.
full_text_anchor: Full text, TGI and TGI-OS model development and External qualification: CONFIRM fitting with PALOMA-3 and SANDPIPER validation.

title: DITTO: A Visual Digital Twin for Interventions and Temporal Treatment Outcomes in Head and Neck Cancer.
qc_rationale: DITTO learns sequential treatment-state and outcome relationships from head-and-neck cancer histories, evaluates personalized short- and long-term outcomes under treatment sequences, and exposes action tradeoffs to clinicians.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Digital twin model and Evaluation: sequential deep-reinforcement-learning state/action representation, quantitative outcome prediction, treatment-policy comparison, and clinician case studies.

title: EczemaPred: A computational framework for personalised prediction of eczema severity dynamics.
qc_rationale: Bayesian state-space models learn latent eczema-severity transitions and measurement processes, then directly forecast daily-to-weekly patient trajectories in two independent longitudinal cohorts.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Methods and Validation: nine latent severity-item models, PO-SCORAD trajectory composition, and comparison with autoregressive baselines across two studies.

title: Exploring the suitability of piecewise-linear dynamical system models for cognitive neural dynamics.
qc_rationale: Recurrent switching linear dynamical systems are fitted to neural time series and directly evaluated for future-state and neural-activity prediction on synthetic and macaque data.
full_text_anchor: Full text, rSLDS model and Evaluation metrics: held-out R2, mean Euclidean distance, synthetic recovery, and future-state prediction on monkey decision-task recordings.

title: Exposure-safety Markov modeling of ocular adverse events in patient populations treated with tisotumab vedotin.
qc_rationale: A discrete-time Markov transition model is fitted to daily ocular-event states and drug exposure from seven trials, validated by predictive checks, and used for regimen simulations.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Model development, Model evaluation, and Model application: daily state transitions, exposure effects, VPCs, and alternative-dose trajectory simulations.

title: Fast-acting insulin aspart (Fiasp®) improves glycemic outcomes when used with MiniMed
qc_rationale: The study runs a pre-existing virtual-patient simulator and closed-loop algorithm after matching fixed pharmacokinetic profiles; it does not learn or adapt the glucose transition from observed patient trajectories.
full_text_anchor: Primary article, Methods: 7,485 existing virtual patients were assigned one of 67 PK profiles and simulated for 90 days; clinical data were used only for comparison.

title: Forecasting Alzheimer’s Disease Progression via Identity-preserved Denoising Diffusion Generative Adversarial Network
qc_rationale: IP-DDGAN learns subject-conditioned longitudinal MRI transitions and directly evaluates generated future scans for identity preservation, morphology, image fidelity, and disease-stage progression.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint, Method and Results: metadata-guided diffusion-GAN forecasting of longitudinal ADNI MRI with multi-horizon image and phenotype evaluation.

title: From mechanistic models to artificial intelligence: exploring the potential of digital twins in geriatric oncology.
qc_rationale: The article combines a broad literature discussion with a synthetic frailty/Markov-decision case study; no transition model is learned or adapted from observed patient trajectories and operationally validated.
full_text_anchor: Full text sections: Literature review; Synthetic data generation; Frailty transitions; Markov decision process framework; simulated case-study Results.

title: From virtual to reality: innovative practices of digital twins in tumor therapy.
qc_rationale: The scoping review spans imaging, diagnosis, surgery, microenvironment analysis, drug development, prognosis, and decisions; learned transition and rollout evidence is not the dominant organizing category.
full_text_anchor: Full text sections: Data sources; AI algorithms; Diagnosis; Surgical planning; Drug development and virtual trials; Prognosis; Treatment decision-making.

title: Generating whole-brain neural activity and behavior through unified latent dynamics
qc_rationale: NEBULA learns shared neural-behavioral latent transitions from whole-brain recordings, evaluates long-horizon free generation, and performs targeted perturbation and steering interventions.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint, Results: C. elegans whole-brain and behavior generation, transition-point perturbations, and controlled state steering without retraining.

title: Generative "Medical Time Travel" Simulators for Disease Progression Forecasting
qc_rationale: The indexed conference title suggests temporal generation, but no stable abstract or full methods/results source was available to verify the learned transition, clinical data, or trajectory evaluation.
full_text_anchor: IEEE DOI and Crossref metadata: bibliographic registration only; no inspectable primary evidence supporting full extraction.

title: Generative modeling of clinical time series via latent stochastic differential equations.
qc_rationale: A latent neural SDE learns controlled stochastic clinical transitions and directly evaluates probabilistic rollout and uncertainty calibration on simulated PK/PD, glucose, and real ICU trajectories.
full_text_anchor: Primary article abstract and methods: variational state estimation, modality-specific emissions, and comparisons with latent ODE, CDE, and LSTM baselines.

title: Graph Representation Forecasting of Patient's Medical Conditions: Toward a Digital Twin.
qc_rationale: The GNN/GAN framework is demonstrated only on two simulated clinical case studies and synthetic multiscale inputs; no learned transition is evaluated against observed longitudinal patient states.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Methods and Results: simulated organ/tissue/cellular cases, endpoint forecasting, and transcriptomic proof of concept without real longitudinal validation.

title: Hierarchical Bayesian modelling of disease progression to inform clinical trial design in centronuclear myopathy.
qc_rationale: A hierarchical Bayesian transition is fitted to each patient's natural-history FEV1 trajectory, then untreated futures are simulated and prospectively compared with observed post-treatment outcomes.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Statistical model and Results: four-year natural history, posterior untreated trajectories, responder criterion, type-I-error calibration, and trial-power assessment.

title: How to improve statistical power in a trial with SCA2 patients using natural history data.
qc_rationale: Disease Course Mapping learns natural-history progression and forecasts one-year SARA change; the predicted transition is operationally tested in trial estimators and sample-size reduction analyses.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Methods and Results: external natural-history training, one-year prognostic scores, ATRIL trial application, variance comparison, and power calculations.

title: Human Digital Twin for Personalized Elderly Type 2 Diabetes Management.
qc_rationale: The article is published in an MDPI journal, which is excluded by the active literature source policy; it is not retained despite reporting an adaptive control simulation.
full_text_anchor: PMC full text and DOI identify Journal of Clinical Medicine as the venue; the system combines mathematical models, deep learning, and learning-based MPC.

title: Hybrid deep learning-mechanistic modeling of cellular dynamics from a spatiotemporal single-cell atlas.
qc_rationale: A VAE-neural-ODE learns continuous cell-state transitions and provides trajectories used to fit an interpretable regulatory model; short-term forecasts and gene-pair perturbations are directly evaluated.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint, Methods and Results: latent neural-ODE reconstruction of six developmental time points, held-out prediction, and mechanistic coupling perturbations.

title: Inferring Trajectories of Psychotic Disorders Using Dynamic Causal Modeling.
qc_rationale: A hierarchical dynamic causal model is fitted to four years of dense symptom time series, reconstructs latent psychosis-course transitions, and is evaluated through parameter-recovery and held-out pattern classification.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Model and Validation: nine empirical patients, simulated-subject parameter recovery, PEB course-pattern estimation, and leave-one-out comparisons.

title: Integrated Longitudinal Population Dose-Hemoglobin Response of Daprodustat Following Dose Titration in Patients With Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease.
qc_rationale: A population dose-response transition with precursor and red-cell transit compartments is fitted to 53,535 longitudinal observations and evaluated by titration-based predictive checks.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Model development and Evaluation: five Phase III studies, dose-driven production-rate dynamics, dialysis-dependent progression, and observed-versus-simulated hemoglobin trajectories.

title: Interpretable learning of temporal cellular dynamics from single-cell data.
qc_rationale: NeuroVelo learns a nonlinear neural-ODE transition in an optimized latent space and directly evaluates cell-type transitions and gene-regulatory dynamics across benchmark single-cell datasets.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Method and Benchmark Results: optimal projection plus neural ODE, transition reconstruction, regulatory-network recovery, and comparisons with RNA-velocity methods.

title: Is San Diego California on Track to Reach HCV Elimination? A Modeling Analysis of Combination Prevention Strategies.
qc_rationale: The article is published in an MDPI journal, which is excluded by the active literature source policy; its transition is also a pre-specified deterministic epidemic model calibrated to aggregate data.
full_text_anchor: PMC full text and DOI identify Viruses as the venue; Methods adapt and calibrate a deterministic HCV transmission and progression model.

title: Koopman-based linearization of preparatory EEG dynamics in Parkinson's disease during galvanic vestibular stimulation.
qc_rationale: A deep Koopman operator learns EEG state transitions from patient recordings, predicts preparatory trajectories under stimulation, and supports simulated LQR steering toward healthy dynamics.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Methods and Results: PD and control EEG under sham and two GVS conditions, eigenanalysis, trajectory fit, motor correlations, and LQR control.

title: Latent process model of the 6-minute walk test in Duchenne muscular dystrophy : A Bayesian approach to quantifying rare disease progression.
qc_rationale: A Bayesian nonlinear mixed-effects latent process is fitted to longitudinal 6-minute-walk data, evaluates population variability, and supports posterior simulation of complete disease trajectories.
full_text_anchor: Primary article, Model and Results: 218 Duchenne patients plus controls, full Bayesian estimation, age-dependent rise and decline, and posterior simulation use.

title: Learning Covariate Relations in Disease Progression Models Using Symbolic Neural Networks.
qc_rationale: Symbolic neural networks jointly learn patient-covariate effects and Markov transition parameters from type 2 diabetes progression observations, with predictive performance compared against a manually developed model.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Method and Application: joint symbolic-function and transition fitting, pruning to readable covariate relations, and diabetes prediction comparison.

title: Learning Temporal Basis Vectors for Closed-Loop Neural Stimulation.
qc_rationale: The temporal-basis model learns stimulation-conditioned neural transitions from primate recordings, forecasts responses, and is operationally evaluated in simulated model-predictive closed-loop control.
full_text_anchor: Primary article abstract and methods: 40 micro-ECoG sessions, past activity plus stimulation inputs, baseline comparisons, and two closed-loop shaping experiments.

title: LNODE: Uncovering the Latent Dynamics of A β in Alzheimer's Disease.
qc_rationale: LNODE fits subject- and cohort-level latent ODE transitions to regional amyloid-PET trajectories and directly evaluates longitudinal fit and progression subtypes.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Model and Results: 585 ADNI subjects, joint parameter inversion, regional normal/abnormal amyloid states, latent mechanisms, and trajectory R-squared.

title: Longitudinal Synthetic Data Generation by Artificial Intelligence to Accelerate Clinical and Translational Research in Breast Cancer.
qc_rationale: The generative models are evaluated for synthetic-data fidelity, privacy, and downstream utility; they do not directly evaluate a learned transition through future-state forecasting, recursive rollout, or action response.
full_text_anchor: Full text, SAFE evaluation and three settings: synthetic i2b2 integration, downstream multistate modeling, and synthetic trial-control replication.

title: Mapping the future of medicine through digital twins.
qc_rationale: The focused survey spans general health systems, cardiology, oncology, and mental health at a conceptual level; learned or adapted dynamics with direct rollout evidence are not a central evidence category.
full_text_anchor: Full text sections: What are digital twins; applications in general health, heart, oncology, and mental health; challenges and future directions.

title: Maximizing Knowledge Extraction From Patient-Reported Outcome Data Using Exposure-Outcome Item Response Modeling Approach: Understanding Efavirenz-Induced Central Nervous System Toxicity.
qc_rationale: A longitudinal item-response transition is fitted to repeated neuropsychiatric symptoms and efavirenz exposure, then used to simulate symptom trajectories under alternative dosing.
full_text_anchor: Primary article abstract and model description: 4,136 observations, latent impairment progression, drug effect, model fit, and 400-mg symptom simulations.

title: Med-Real2Sim: Non-Invasive Medical Digital Twins using Physics-Informed Self-Supervised Learning and Virtual Patient Breathing Simulator using VR
qc_rationale: The DOI record reproduces and extends the title of the earlier complete Med-Real2Sim preprint without a separately auditable methods contribution; the stable original lineage should be retained instead.
full_text_anchor: Lineage check: the core work is available as arXiv:2403.11718, while the 2026 low-signal DOI adds a VR phrase but exposes no separate stable methods/results text.

title: Medical digital twin insights: Enhancing cancer treatment through generative modeling.
qc_rationale: The article gives a high-level narrative of generative twins in cancer but no reproducible review method or central evidence synthesis of learned transitions and operational dynamics evaluations.
full_text_anchor: Publisher abstract: general claims about multimodal data, tumor behavior, treatment simulation, efficacy, and toxicity without a searchable evidence-selection protocol.

title: Medical Digital Twin: A Review on Technical Principles and Clinical Applications.
qc_rationale: The review is published in an MDPI journal, which is excluded by the active literature source policy; its scope also broadly covers principles and applications rather than transition evidence.
full_text_anchor: PMC full text and DOI identify Journal of Clinical Medicine as the venue.

title: Modelling neural coding in the auditory midbrain with high resolution and accuracy.
qc_rationale: ICNet learns sound-conditioned temporal neural-response dynamics from large intracranial recordings and directly evaluates simulated multineuron activity, adaptation, and forward masking.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Model and Results: gerbil inferior-colliculus recordings, convolutional encoder-decoder simulation, held-out sound responses, speech, adaptation, and masking phenomena.

title: Multi-Objective Model-based Reinforcement Learning for Infectious Disease Control
qc_rationale: A Bayesian epidemiological transition model is learned at each decision point and used for multi-objective planning; Pareto policies and predictive bands are evaluated on COVID-19 control data.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint, Methods and application: learned environment model, model-based rollout, policy-front estimation, uncertainty bands, and China COVID-19 intervention analysis.

title: Myo-ODE: continuous-time trajectory reconstruction and risk prediction of high myopia via neural ordinary differential equations.
qc_rationale: Myo-ODE learns continuous refractive-state transitions from irregular longitudinal screening data and directly evaluates interpolation, short-term extrapolation, individualized trajectories, and risk prediction.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Methods and Results: 4,973 longitudinal records, neural ODE trajectory reconstruction, held-out intervals, F1/recall/AUC, and progression-momentum interpretation.

title: New PK/PD model directly links diabetes drug dose to blood glucose level for personalized care.
qc_rationale: A personalized dose-glucose transition plus disease-progression term is fitted to daily self-monitored glucose, then evaluated for long-term drug-response forecasting and dose optimization.
full_text_anchor: Full text, Model and Results: first-month gestational-diabetes data used for fitting, personalized dose-response estimation, and comparison with autoregression for later glucose trends.

title: Optical compression of multimodal clinical data into a unified visual memory for generative trajectory forecasting
qc_rationale: The system predicts separate deterioration outcomes at fixed 3- to 48-hour horizons and evaluates AUROC and warning lead time; it does not directly validate a coherent evolving state transition or recursive rollout.
full_text_anchor: Primary preprint, Methods and Results: multimodal visual-token memory, eight outcome-domain decoders, fixed-horizon classification, AUROC, and event warning-time metrics.

title: Optimized glycemic control of type 2 diabetes with reinforcement learning: a proof-of-concept trial.
